pages.p7: Frau Amrein — a fifty-five-year-old tall, slim woman with silver hair pulled back into a tight bun, pale blue eyes behind rectangular reading glasses, wearing a dark green fitted blazer, crisp white blouse, grey tailored trousers, and black leather flat shoes — stands at the left rim of the freshly opened circular shaft, body upright, facing right across the hole. Fiona — an adult woman with light brown, straight, neck-length hair brushed back, blue eyes, silver necklace with heart pendant, silver bracelet, wearing a wide-brimmed blue tricorn hat with the brim turned up at the front, loose white linen blouse, brown leather corset laced up the front, dark blue wide-leg sailor trousers cropped just below the knee, and brown leather knee-high boots with a fold-over cuff — stands at the right rim of the shaft, facing left toward Frau Amrein, both hands holding the rolled parchment chart tightly behind her back. Sarah — a young adult young woman with blonde, wavy, shoulder-length hair, blue eyes, small gold stud earrings, light freckles, wearing a red wide-brimmed tricorn hat with the brim pinned up on one side, loose red linen blouse, black wide-leg sailor trousers cropped just below the knee, black buckled ankle boots, and red fabric sash tied at the waist — stands beside Fiona, facing left, gazing down into the shaft. Facundo — a young adult young man with dark brown, wavy, short tousled hair, brown eyes, clean-shaven face, beaded necklace, wearing an orange wide-brimmed tricorn hat worn at a crooked angle, loose orange linen shirt, brown leather waistcoat with front lapels worn open, dark brown wide-leg sailor trousers cropped just below the knee, brown leather knee-high boots with a fold-over cuff, and orange fabric sash tied loosely at the waist — stands beside Sarah, facing left, gazing down into the shaft.
